description.value:
You've refined your powers to punish those who barely dodge them.

When a creature rolls a natural 1 on a saving throw against a damaging power you cast, it instead takes the maximum possible result on the damage die.

You learn one at-will power that requires a saving throw; your casting ability for it is Wisdom or Charisma (matching the power's alignment) for a force power, or Intelligence for a tech power.

system.requirements: 4th level, the ability to cast force or tech powers.
